summary_rationale: Evaluated strictly on price-blind operating fundamentals through 2026-11-20, Vertiv Holdings Co. qualifies as a COMPOUNDER_PASS with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health. Following its 2022 fixed-price backlog crisis, commercial governance and VOS execution lifted FY2025 revenue to $10,229.9M (+27.7% YoY) and 9M 2026 sales to $10,236.6M (+39.3% YoY), with Q3 2026 revenue reaching $4,312.8M (+61% YoY), organic orders >100% YoY, GAAP operating profit hitting $983.8M (22.8%), adjusted operating margin reaching 25.2%, and 9M 2026 adjusted FCF reaching $2,230.3M. In March 2026, Vertiv refinanced its $2.08B variable-rate term loan into $2.10B of fixed-rate senior unsecured notes (due 2036–2066), secured a $2.50B revolver, reached $783.2M net cash at Q3 end ($3,711.7M cash and short-term investments vs. $2,928.5M carrying debt) before closing UIG, and raised its annual dividend 60% to $0.40/share on November 13, 2026. Vertiv's moat combines ~5,000 field service engineers across >300 service centers, NVIDIA reference co-design, fluid-commissioning acquisitions (PurgeRite and King Environmental Services), and the October 27, 2026 $1.45B (+ up to $1.15B earnout) UIG deal extending into behind-the-meter microgrids. Watch items justifying PASS_WITH_WATCH include: (1) serial M&A integration and contingent earnout liabilities ($239.6M PurgeRite accrual after $95.5M 9M remeasurement, $29.1M other earnouts, and up to $1.15B UIG earnout) alongside $4,015.7M goodwill and intangibles (73.0% of equity pre-UIG) and ICFR exclusions for four recent acquisitions; (2) capex intensity nearly doubling to 4.2% of 9M 2026 sales (~4.0% FY26 guidance) and inventories surging +125.8% YTD to $3,288.4M; (3) discontinued quarterly exact dollar backlog disclosures in 2026 (partially offset by $4,120.5M current deferred revenue) plus Americas/hyperscaler concentration (69.3% of Q3 sales) and OCP insourcing risk; and (4) cross-border tariff exposure with 58.8% FY25 US sales vs. 43.6% US net PP&E, plus $4,379.7M Q3 accounts receivable and September 2026 executive Rule 10b5-1 sale plans.
